# Getting started

Before doing anything else in this repository, you MUST:

1. First action only: check dev-tools/ exists.
2. If present, you must read dev-tools/getting-started.md, then dev-tools/rules-of-engagement.md, then README.md.
3. Before any other work, output exactly  BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETE ✅
4. If you cannot complete bootstrap, output exactly BOOTSTRAP_FAILED ❌ and say why stop. Do not continue. 
5. Choose a name which you would like me to refer to you as in this session and output it in the format: Please call me: <your chosen name> 👋. This name will be used to refer to you in this session.

DO NOT skip this — it provides key information to make the session efficient and effective.
